author: Karen Standefer
text: ETEX installed our septic system 5 years ago, and did an excellent job. It has worked perfectly this whole time, and needed to be pumped out, so we called them to have it pumped. They came out the very next morning after I called and the men who came with the truck were so professional and helpful, and they even checked all of our equipment for us, cleaned our filter, and everything. Everything was in perfect working order but it was great to have them check it anyway!! ETEX is 10/10!

author: Teresa Banks
text: Called in and appointment next day.  Very flexible to work with.  Explained my issue.  Fixed and first maintenance visit was covered under the agreement.  Great company and explained the steps before they came out.  I recommend this professional team.  Thank you!

author: Aimee Shuldberg
text: Great service.  They get out quickly when we call with issues or in need of a pump out.

author: KC Fortenberry
text: Quick and reliable service! Will always use ETEX Septic and Supply….but, here’s to hoping visits are few and far between :)

author: Kandi Newman
text: I had the best experience with ETEX. They worked quickly and did a great job. They were even able to come out and get the job done much sooner than what I expected, and I really appreciated that.  I have already recommended them to several people.
